title: HELIX Govern: Data Governance Role Definitions
description: Standard governance roles for higher education institutions adopting HELIX. Institutions map these roles to their organizational structure. A single person may hold multiple roles; a single role may be shared across people.

roles.description: Senior executive (VP, Provost, CFO) with ultimate accountability for a data domain. Approves policies, resolves cross-domain disputes, and champions data governance at the cabinet level.
responsibilities: Approve data policies for their domain
Resolve data definition disputes that Data Stewards cannot settle
Ensure adequate resources for governance within their domain
Champion data literacy and governance culture
helix_domains: All — one trustee per major domain

roles.description: Senior leader responsible for the institution's overall data strategy, governance program, and HELIX adoption. May report to the CIO, Provost, or President depending on institutional structure.
responsibilities: Own the institutional data governance framework
Coordinate HELIX adoption across domains
Establish and maintain the data governance council
Oversee data quality, classification, and compliance programs
Report governance health metrics to leadership

roles.description: Functional expert who defines, documents, and maintains data definitions and quality rules within a specific domain (enrollment, financial aid, HR, etc.). The steward is the authoritative voice on 'what does this data mean?' for their domain.
responsibilities: Define and maintain business definitions for HELIX resources in their domain
Validate HELIX terminology code sets against institutional reality
Establish and monitor data quality rules
Approve access requests for confidential/restricted data in their domain
Resolve data quality issues escalated by Data Custodians
Participate in the data governance council

roles.description: Technical role responsible for the physical management, security, and operational quality of data in systems and the data lake. Implements the policies defined by Data Stewards.
responsibilities: Implement HELIX Bridge mappings from ERP to data lake
Enforce data classification and access controls (per HELIX meta.classification)
Monitor data quality metrics and alert Stewards on failures
Maintain data lineage documentation
Execute schema migrations when HELIX Core versions up
Manage backup, retention, and disaster recovery for governed data

roles.description: Any person who accesses HELIX-governed data for analysis, reporting, research, or decision-making. Consumers are responsible for using data appropriately within their authorized scope.
responsibilities: Use data within authorized scope and classification level
Report data quality issues to the appropriate Data Steward
Complete data literacy training as required by the institution
Cite data sources and acknowledge governance context in reports
Do not redistribute restricted/confidential data outside authorized channels

roles.description: An individual who advocates for HELIX adoption, contributes back to the open framework, and serves as a community resource. This is a recognition role, not a job title.
typical_titles: Any of the above — this is an overlay role
responsibilities: Evangelize HELIX within their institution and professional networks
Contribute ERP mappings, profiles, or extensions back to the HELIX community
Participate in HELIX community reviews and feedback cycles
Serve as a reference contact for institutions exploring HELIX adoption
